reasoning: Bitcoin needs only a ~49% increase from ~$87K to reach $130K by end of 2026, which is modest given historical bull-market volatility and the post-halving uptrend (halving April 2024). The market's 12.5% implied probability seems far too low, likely underestimating the chance of even a brief spike above $130K. I estimate a roughly 45% probability, creating a large edge.
evidence_points: Current BTC price ~$87K, a 49% gain to $130K is small relative to historical bull-run multiples (e.g., 2020-2021: ~7x from $10K).
Post-halving cycles typically see peak prices within 12-18 months; many forecasts target $124K-$250K, placing $130K at the lower end.
Resolution requires only one 1-minute candle high ≥$130K, so a temporary spike suffices, increasing the likelihood.
Diminishing cycle returns still suggest a high probability of a new ATH well above $130K from the $15.5K 2022 low.
